overlay_message:
SenseiX requires the 'Display over other apps' permission to allow performance optimization and real-time overlays to function smoothly in the background.

• Displays real-time performance stats
• Prevents the optimization process from being terminated by the system
• Completely safe and does not collect any personal data
act_shizuku_desc: Use a running Shizuku. Fast, no pairing needed.
act_wireless_desc: No Shizuku needed. Uses Wireless debugging over Wi-Fi.
act_wireless_hint: Open Wireless debugging > Pair device with pairing code, then type the code in the notification.
battery_message:
To ensure the PING and FPS indicators run smoothly while gaming or in the background, please set SenseiX battery usage to 'Unrestricted'.

Steps after tapping the button below:
1. Select the 'Battery' menu.
2. Change from 'Optimized' to 'Unrestricted'.
err_create_folder: Failed to create the destination folder.
power_dialog_message:
SenseiX will go offline and stop using the active service (Shizuku or Wireless debugging).

Your pairing is kept, so you can activate it again later by just tapping the status card.
power_toast_off: Service turned off. SenseiX is offline.
act_needs_android11: Wireless debugging requires Android 11 or newer
act_notif_permission: Notification permission is required to enter the pairing code
act_wireless_off_hint: Wireless debugging is off. Turn it on, then come back to the app (no re-pairing needed).
adb_err_not_found: Wireless debugging service not found (turn it on and connect to Wi-Fi)

adb_notif_enter_code: Type the 6-digit code from Wireless debugging.

adb_notif_not_found: Pairing service not found yet. Open Wireless debugging > Pairing code.
adb_notif_code_invalid: The code must be 6 digits. Try again.
adb_notif_port_inactive: The pairing port is not active (pairing code dialog closed). Open "Pair device with pairing code" again; this notification will update.
